export_policy.method: Explicit field lists; an unknown source field stops the export. Samples, intervals, numeric metadata and hashes are copied without rounding.

Local process names and identifiers; each check's count of allowed idle GPU contexts is retained
excluded_fields.settings.allowed_idle_process_ids: Local process identifiers; their count is retained
excluded_fields.leg.stdout, stderr, monitor_stdout, moni: Local file names; artifact hashes and structured telemetry are retained
excluded_fields.metadata.python_executable: A local path, replaced by the interpreter's recorded SHA-256
excluded_fields.metadata.scheduling*.process_id: A local process identifier; the scheduling readback is retained
excluded_fields.metadata.provider_options.TensorrtExecut: Local cache directories; the cache files' hashes are retained

limitations: CPU legs ran on six efficiency cores of an Intel Core i5-13500 at nice 19 under a six-CPU quota, on a server that also runs other workloads.
GPU legs shared the GPU with another workload's idle compute context, admitted by process ID; every gate reading before a GPU leg showed at most 5% utilization.

Each engine ran in one configuration that takes any length: ONNX Runtime CUDA with a symbolic sequence length, TensorRT with one profile over 16 to 512 tokens at builder level 5, PyTorch eagerly. Padding inputs to a few fixed lengths and engines split by length range are not part of the measurement.
One text a call; batches are not measured.
One GPU, an NVIDIA RTX 4000 SFF Ada Generation with 48 multiprocessors under its 70 W power limit; other GPUs are not measured.
